title: Release-Verifier vollständig ressourcengebunden abschließen
goal: Schließe die Ressourcenhärtung des RepoGround-Release-Verifiers auf Basis des gemergten PR #1113 ab. Bewahre die inzwischen gemergten Grenzen für Manifest, SHA256SUMS, Symlinks, Archive und Git-Blob-Gesamtgröße, halte weiterhin höchstens einen Blob gleichzeitig im Speicher und verwende beim source-bound Vergleich genau einen geöffneten Leser für den bereits materialisierten Tar-Inhalt, ohne fremde schmutzige Checkouts zu verändern.

approval.note: The user request in the active ChatGPT conversation authorizes exactly this isolated RepoGround T019 implementation. The claim must remain task-bound; a complete diff, revision-bound review, green tests and green CI are required before merge.

acceptance.assertion: Implementation starts from RepoGround merge commit 37a83704695532f8c8d17a532709e3de92cafb38 or a proven descendant and preserves the archive, member, decompressed-stream, compression-ratio and member-count limits delivered by PR #1113.

The release manifest and SHA256SUMS have explicit byte ceilings, are required to be regular non-symlink files, and are rejected before full parsing or line processing when those contracts are violated.
Source-bound verification rejects the aggregate size of all immutable Git blobs before starting the content batch when it exceeds the explicit repository-content ceiling.
The persistent git cat-file content batch holds, verifies and discards at most one bounded blob at a time and does not accumulate the full repository content in memory.

The source-bound repository comparison opens the already materialized Tar content exactly once, reuses validated TarInfo.offset_data positions for all regular entries and preserves all existing size, type, mode, symlink and content checks.

Regression tests cover oversized and symlinked manifest input, oversized SHA256SUMS, aggregate repository-blob overflow before content reads, one-at-a-time blob handling, one Tar reader for source-bound comparison and the existing archive/PAX/GNU resource-limit cases.

Targeted release tests, repository hygiene, Ruff, maintainability ratchets, full pytest, CodeQL and post-merge CI are green on the final reviewed head; the proof distinguishes PR #1113 baseline evidence from the closeout patch.

remaining_findings: candidate manifest and SHA256SUMS are read without explicit pre-read byte ceilings
source-bound Git blob sizes are individually bounded but not aggregate-bounded before content streaming

reviewed_plan.basis: PR #1113 and merge commit 37a83704695532f8c8d17a532709e3de92cafb38 were read back with green post-merge CI. The original two remaining limits are present on the current RepoGround descendant. A later digest-bound read additionally showed that the source-bound comparison reopens the already materialized Tar file for each regular entry.

activation.basis: User requested autonomous selection and implementation of one RepoGround task through Grabowski.
